Class UpdateMercuryTransactionsSchedulable

public without sharing class UpdateMercuryTransactionsSchedulable
implements Schedulable

Schedulable wrapper for UpdateMercuryTransactionsQueueable. Configured via the standard scheduler so the Mercury reconciliation chain kicks off on a recurring interval; the queueable then walks every pending transaction one at a time.
